claims.title: Invertible row-stochastic latent gauges preserve a one-view mixture law under the compensating prior transformation
claims.scope: finite latent mixture q=pi K, invertible row-stochastic A, and transformed prior pi A^{-1} remaining nonnegative
assumptions: component and observed alphabets are finite
nonclaims: observational equivalence is not physical identity

claims.title: An invertible row-stochastic latent gauge preserves affine rank of the component emission rows
claims.scope: finite categorical channels transformed as K'=AK
nonclaims: conditioning constants need not be preserved

claims.title: Interior finite mixtures admit a local continuum of nontrivial observationally equivalent prior-channel factorizations
claims.scope: interior latent prior and a channel with at least two affinely independent rows
assumptions: a nonidentity row-stochastic perturbation is chosen sufficiently close to the identity so the transformed prior remains nonnegative
nonclaims: the theorem does not characterize every observational equivalence

claims.title: Full affine identifiability conditional on a known channel does not imply joint identifiability of unknown mixing weights and unknown emission rows
claims.scope: one-view finite latent-mixture observations with both pi and K allowed to vary
assumptions: only the one-view mixture law pi K is observed
nonclaims: additional views, labels, interventions, or structural restrictions can restore identifiability

claims.title: Infinite one-view sample size cannot resolve exact latent-mixture gauge equivalence
claims.scope: two valid factorizations producing exactly the same one-view observed distribution
assumptions: sampling only refines knowledge of that same marginal observed law
nonclaims: the result is structural nonidentifiability rather than a statement about finite-sample efficiency

claims.title: A binary nonpermutation gauge changes prior (1/2,1/2) to (2/3,1/3) while preserving observed law (1/2,1/2)
claims.scope: binary identity channel and upper-triangular gauge with first row (3/4,1/4)
nonclaims: the witness is one member of a continuum

claims.title: A three-component nonpermutation stochastic gauge preserves full affine rank and the uniform observed law while changing both prior and channel
claims.scope: identity K3, uniform prior, and the exact upper-triangular gauge in repository tests
assumptions: the transformed prior remains in the simplex
nonclaims: the example does not exhaust higher-dimensional gauge freedom

claims.title: Bounded exact latent-mixture gauge audit
claims.scope: binary witness, rational near-identity family, three-component full-rank witness, independent same-law factorization, and invalid-gauge rejection
assumptions: all matrices use exact rational arithmetic
nonclaims: bounded examples are not empirical evidence for simulation
